conventions.A_action_both: nontranspose A->L^{-T} A R^{-T}; transpose A->R^{-1} A^T L^{-1}, matching wang_capacity_lazy.basis_image_for_action.
conventions.proof_convention: T[3*i+j, 3*j+k, 3*i+k]=1; C is N0 x N2; nontranspose companion B->R^T B, C->L C; transpose companion B->L C, C->R^T B.
conventions.source_wang: T[3*i+j, 3*j+k, 3*k+i]=1; C is N2 x N0; nontranspose companion B->R^T B, C->C L^T; transpose companion B->L C^T, C->B^T R.

meaning: Exact finite check that every A-side transport action used for Wang certificate witnesses is the A component of a matrix-multiplication tensor automorphism, in both the source/Wang C-index convention and the proof C-index convention. Also checks the source-convention split-flattening product formula on all elementary pairs.
